headline: Premier League live updates: Aston Villa host league leaders Man City
description: Aston Villa host Premier League leaders Manchester City as another weekend of European soccer gets underway.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea, Bayern, Barcelona battle for Brighton defender
description: Chelsea, Bayern Munich and Barcelona are targeting Brighton & Hove Albion defender Luka Vuskovic. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Nottingham Forest rue 'wrong' red card call, missed chances in Ipswich draw
description: Nottingham Forest lamented the referee's decision not to reduce Ipswich Town to 10 men in the second half, as well a number of missed chances in front of goal, after a 1-1 draw at Portman Road.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi defends Spurs' 'high level' medical staff amid injury crisis
description: Roberto De Zerbi has defended Tottenham's medical staff despite an ongoing injury crisis.

headline: Ipswich earn draw with Forest as Delap misfires on return
description: Liam Delap fired a blank on his return to Ipswich with Nottingham Forest forced to settle for a 1-1 draw despite a dominant display at Portman Road.

headline: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso: Thibaut Courtois sees himself in Mike Penders
description: Xabi Alonso believes understudy goalkeeper Mike Penders is ready for an extended spell in Chelsea's team after consulting on the 21-year-old with Thibaut Courtois.
